directed_utterances.utterance_text: I hear what you're saying, and part of me wants to believe that... but I've tried to "build something new" before and it just kind of fell apart, so I'm not sure why this time would be different. Like, the loneliness doesn't go away just because I reframe it — I still go home to an empty apartment every night and that's just the reality. I guess I'm scared that if I start hoping for something different, I'll just end up more disappointed than I already am.
